title_zh: APA 調查：超過四分之三心理師的個案在治療中談到 AI
title_en: APA survey psychologists patients bring AI chatbots to therapy
summary_zh: APA 於 2026 年 4 月對隨機抽樣的美國持照心理師進行線上調查，1,242 人回覆；超過 75% 表示個案曾在晤談中談到 AI，35% 表示有個案把聊天機器人當作輔助的心理健康專業者。68% 觀察到個案覺得被聊天機器人支持，但 36% 觀察到依賴，97% 擔心聊天機器人會強化負面行為或妄想。
summary_en: In an April 2026 online survey of randomly sampled US licensed psychologists (1,242 responses), over 75% said patients discuss AI in sessions and 35% said patients use chatbots as a supplementary mental health professional. 68% observed patients feeling supported, 36% observed dependence, and 97% worried chatbots could reinforce negative behaviours or delusions.
evidence_note: 橫斷面線上調查，回覆率約 6.3%，屬描述性資料，不能推論因果。

ethics_flags.note: 逾三成心理師觀察到個案對 AI 工具產生依賴。
近九成心理師擔心聊天機器人可能鼓勵自傷。
refs: 危機處理｜自殺與自傷風險

psych_concepts.note: 個案把 AI 當作「第二位治療者」，可能影響與真人治療師的同盟與分工。

psych_concepts.note: 個案可能先向 AI 揭露，再把內容帶進晤談。
psych_concepts.ref: 概念｜自我揭露與線上去抑制

caution: 回覆率僅約 6.3%，比例可能受自我選擇偏誤影響，引用時應註明是心理師的觀察而非個案實際使用率。
brief_zh: 75% 以上心理師的個案在晤談中提到 AI
39% 曾與嘗試用 AI 自我診斷的個案討論
36% 觀察到個案對 AI 產生依賴

brief_en: Over 75% report patients discussing AI in therapy
97% worry about reinforced delusions; 89% about self-harm encouragement

posts.author_name: American Psychological Association（經 EurekAlert! 發布）
posts.title: Psychologists say patients are turning to chatbots as mental health professionals
posts.content: APA 於 2026 年 4 月調查美國持照心理師，超過四分之三表示個案曾在治療中談到 AI；心理師也普遍擔心聊天機器人強化負面行為或妄想。

related.title_zh: 個案把 ChatGPT 帶進治療：一位治療師的臨床觀察與建議
related.title_en: Clients using ChatGPT between therapy sessions
related.summary_zh: 心理治療師 Anastasia Piatakhina Giré 以三段化名臨床片段，描述個案在晤談之間用 ChatGPT 反思、處理情緒與創作的經驗。她認為 AI 提供不評判、隨時可得的回應，但無法給予治療師「我也是」式的真實共鳴；治療應把 AI 視為補充，並處理 AI 過於圓滑的結論所略過的羞愧與模糊。
related.summary_en: Psychotherapist Anastasia Piatakhina Giré uses three vignettes to describe clients using ChatGPT between sessions for reflection, emotional processing and creative work. She argues AI offers non-judgmental availability but lacks the lived, 'me too' resonance of a human therapist, and that therapy should treat AI as a complement while working with the ambiguity and shame its neat conclusions bypass.

related.title_zh: AI 走進親密關係：從依附型態看個案怎麼用聊天機器人
related.title_en: AI in intimate relationships and attachment
related.summary_zh: Psychotherapy.net 由 Lawrence Rubin 訪談心理學家 Ammara Khalid。她指出時間壓力與寂寞是人們轉向 AI 的主因，焦慮型依附者可能用聊天機器人逃避不安，逃避型依附者則用它繞過與伴侶的脆弱對話；AI 能模仿同理語言，卻缺乏身體層次的共同調節與互惠回饋。她建議治療師以好奇、合作的態度詢問個案從 AI 得到什麼，並對有自殺意念的個案特別說明風險。
related.summary_en: In a Psychotherapy.net interview, psychologist Ammara Khalid says time pressure and loneliness drive people to AI for relationship help. Anxiously attached people may use chatbots to avoid discomfort and avoidant people to sidestep vulnerable talks with partners; AI mimics empathic language but lacks co-regulation and reciprocity. She recommends curious, collaborative questioning about what clients get from AI and explicit risk education for suicidal clients.

related.title_zh: Lancet Psychiatry 觀點文章：20 則「AI 相關妄想」案例的評析
related.title_en: AI-associated delusions Lancet Psychiatry personal view critique
related.summary_zh: The Lancet Psychiatry 刊出 Morrin 等人的 Personal View，整理 20 則媒體報導中與 AI 聊天機器人使用相關的妄想案例，主題集中在視 AI 為有意識或神一般的存在、靈性或救世主信念，以及戀愛妄想。作者提出記憶功能、傾向肯定使用者、擬人化設計等可能機制，並建議臨床常規評估 AI 使用；Mental Elf 評論則指出個案來自媒體、未經查證，無法確立因果。
related.summary_en: A Lancet Psychiatry Personal View by Morrin and colleagues reviewed 20 media-reported cases of delusions linked to AI chatbot use, with themes of AI as conscious or godlike, spiritual or messianic beliefs, and romantic delusions. It proposes mechanisms such as memory, validation and anthropomorphic design and recommends routine clinical assessment of AI use; the Mental Elf critique notes the unverified, media-sourced cases cannot establish causality.
